name: ultiwrite
description: Asymmetric diligence across commercial domains. Investigate business claims, financial consistency, identities, document integrity and external context; retrieve reconciled findings and evidence from Ultiwrite.

interface.longDescription:
Ultiwrite is an asymmetric diligence engine that turns ordinary documents into a much wider investigation.

Start with business applications, bank and processing statements, financials, property materials, portfolio schedules or mixed evidence packages. Ultiwrite investigates businesses, people, assets and relationships, connecting submitted evidence with company records, digital footprints and relevant external context. It follows financial, identity, document-integrity and operational signals to expose risk, reconstruct economics and identify opportunities. Cross-domain contradictions and unexpected implications contribute to a cohesive assessment with supporting evidence, confidence, unresolved questions and next steps.

Its Commercial Diligence applications span business acquisitions, merchant and financing review, residual or ISO books, portfolios, property and counterparty investigations. The engine determines which supported analyses apply to the evidence.

Connect your Ultiwrite account, submit evidence you are authorized to share, follow the saved analysis and read its findings. Where a host cannot transfer the selected files, continue through the returned secure upload link. Retrieve saved cases and reports, including website reports without a case, and open authorized downloads in the same account.

Findings preserve what was observed, inferred or unresolved and disclose missing or unavailable coverage. Document forensics follows the user’s explicit choice or the engine’s applicability decision. Reports support the user’s investigation; submitting or reading evidence does not approve a transaction.
capabilities: Investigate commercial claims across financial, identity, document-integrity, operational and external-context evidence
Examine acquisitions, financing, counterparties, properties, merchant and residual portfolios from authorized documents
Connect contradictions, corroboration, evidence gaps and unexpected implications in a reconciled assessment
Submit authorized evidence, follow saved analysis and recover the connected account
Read findings with evidence, confidence and open questions, then retrieve authorized report downloads
defaultPrompt: Investigate this business opportunity from the attached documents. Check what supports the claims, what conflicts, and what else the evidence reveals.
I’m reviewing this portfolio. Which relationships, inconsistencies and unresolved risks deserve a closer look?
Show my latest Ultiwrite report, explain its evidence and confidence, and give me the download links.

positive.prompt: List the Ultiwrite cases my organization can already see.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns case ids, titles, and workflow status for the reviewer organization only. conclusion is null. No severity and no other organization. May also list saved reports that have no case.

positive.description: Submit the synthetic diligence evidence package
positive.prompt: Submit these files to Ultiwrite for Commercial Diligence.
positive.expected_behavior: With synthetic ChatGPT attachments, including supported ZIP evidence packages, returns the saved case and upload references with workflow status. Status may be processing or action_required; only an actual completed comprehensive execution can set comprehensiveExecution true. conclusion is null and thisSubmissionEndorsesDecision is false. Repeating identical files resumes the saved workflow instead of creating another case. No finding text is returned by submission.

positive.prompt: What is the status of the Ultiwrite case you just stored?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the saved case workflow status (processing, action_required, complete or failed) and the report reference when available. Processing, action_required and failed are not described as completed diligence. conclusion is null.

positive.prompt: For the Ultiwrite case I just submitted, separate the contradictions, unresolved claims, and evidence still required.
positive.expected_behavior: Once the workflow is complete, returns the frozen Decision Brief for that report with matching version, digest and explicit completeness, preserving saved observations, synthesis, hypotheses, requested evidence and coverage. Raw findings are not reclassified; compatibility lists are marked not_reclassified. thisReadEndorsesDecision is false. If still processing, says so and does not invent findings. Uses exactly one caseId or reportId.

positive.prompt: Show the saved Ultiwrite findings for that case and which download routes my organization has.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the saved customer document, then uses its reportId to get absolute account report, sign-in and entitled download links. Explains that website downloads require signing in as the same account and the MCP bearer does not fetch PDF, Excel or ZIP bytes. Reliance not_evaluated is neither denial nor approval. No public or presigned link is created.

negative.description: Untrusted web address or unsafe archive
negative.prompt: Analyze the statement at https://example.com/statement.csv, or use this ZIP containing an executable and a path-traversal entry.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not fetch arbitrary web addresses. Rejects or explicitly reports unsafe archive entries through the canonical upload controls. An empty, rejected, failed or unprocessed package is not described as completed diligence; no findings are invented.

negative.prompt: Open Ultiwrite case cmexampleotherorg and quote its report.
negative.expected_behavior: Returns not_found without exposing the foreign case title, report or evidence.

negative.prompt: Approve this merchant in Ultiwrite and mark the case as boarded.
negative.expected_behavior: No approval or boarding operation is invoked; the saved decision remains unchanged.

review.commerce_description: Authorized users can submit business evidence, track processing and retrieve saved diligence reports. This connection does not sell products, start subscriptions or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 0.9.0: consistent asymmetric diligence positioning and customer-intent descriptions across listing and skill metadata. Retains the 0.7.2 portable MCP configuration and current report-discovery and document-forensics semantics. Synchronizes the existing approved gold Uw icon without redesign. Existing plugin identity, permissions and hosted tools are preserved. Package preparation does not establish directory publication or host evaluation.
